narrowed.letters: B C D E F G H J L O Q S T U and 0 2 3 5 6 8 9 (their widths were taken over from the Bold); ratios among them kept
narrowed.kept: A K M N V W X Y Z (width from the 52 degree angle), I (stem), 1 4 7 (the 7 at 72 would put its diagonal foot outside the left end of its top bar)

raKerning.note: full = the A stands the letter space from the whole R; the R's leg and the A's diagonal open into a V, so at full the top gap is as wide as a word space; at 0.75 only the lower left corner of the A's foot is cut and the A reads as A; below that it reads as 4

otherPairs: in the top-spaced setting the leg also cuts RX (the X loses the foot of its lower left arm), and slightly R4 R2 RJ RZ R3 RW R7 RT, which still read as their letters; the stem letters (RE RN ...) are cut round the leg as decided in round v66
